instruction: Center-align the first paragraph of the document, then save the file

metadata.explanation: Task requires center-aligning the first paragraph. Verified document has paragraph text starting with 'Use this task to view all current organizational relationships...'. Evaluator checks if first non-empty paragraph alignment is CENTER.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts first non-empty paragraph alignment using python-docx library and WD_ALIGN_PARAGRAPH enum
Metric performs correct case-insensitive string comparison for alignment values
Proper file handling: downloads from VM, saves to cache, reads with docx library
Edge cases handled: returns 'LEFT' if alignment is None (default), 'UNKNOWN' if no paragraphs
MINOR ISSUE: Instruction requires TWO steps ('center-align' AND 'save file'), but evaluator only verifies alignment
However, getter reads from disk file, so if alignment is CENTER on disk, it implicitly means file was saved at some point
Postconfig sleep allows time for save operation to complete before verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding explicit file save verification by checking file modification timestamp
Could add a second evaluator step to verify file was saved after alignment change (e.g., compare mtime before/after)
Alternatively, simplify instruction to remove 'save the file' requirement if only alignment matters
